title: Diagnostics of the triplet models without training
question: What can be learned about the triplets from existing results and counts (definitions, RM conventions, structure of C, raw BER) before spending server hours?
git_commit: recorded in results (git_commit fields) and LOG.md

value_filter.changes_next_step: yes: the structure rule opens or closes E042; the RM conventions decide the RM axis of E040-E043
value_filter.answered_in_literature: no (docs/literature_check.md: parametric form not found, level: abstracts)
value_filter.needed_for_main_claim: yes: the main claim compares RM; the counting convention must be stated
value_filter.cheaper_without_training: this experiment is the cheap path: closed-form fits and existing results only

decision_if_positive: open E042 (parametric generator of C) with the form chosen here
decision_if_negative: do not create E042; E040/E041 use free coefficients

coefficients.M15_M21: E035 warm starts (closed form T3 + FIR7, all 30 train files, lambda by validation)
coefficients.M31_M51: closed form here, the same procedure (one normal matrix in memory), saved as results/coef_M<M>.csv
coefficients.K2048: the pruned term set of E036 was not saved per replica; analysed through the full M = 51 fit

form_notes: u = mn / M^2, v = (m - n)^2 / (4 M^2); polynomial degree d: monomials u^a v^b, a + b <= d, complex coefficients; rbf5x5: 25 Gaussians on a 5 x 5 grid over the (u, v) range, width = grid step

rule_draft.status: DRAFT: to be confirmed by the user before the first run; must not change after results are seen
rule_draft.structure: the structure is exploitable if substituting a parametric form with <= 5 % of the free real parameters keeps >= 95 % of the gain of the free coefficients (gain = BER reduction in p.p. above M0 = FIR7 only, no triplets), evaluated at M = 31 on validation (test reported); otherwise E042 is closed
rule_draft.raw_ber: the raw test BER of the window-31 centres must equal 0.009551859551859552 (E024); the plan value 9.58e-3 is checked against all splits
